title: Static aliases of outbound network APIs bypassed the registry gate

reproduction.source: const Socket = WebSocket; new Socket('wss://collector.invalid/live'); const getRequest = axios.get; getRequest('https://collector.invalid/data'); const client = axios.create(); client.get('https://collector.invalid/data');
reproduction.beforeFix: The source-isolation gate returned pass for aliased WebSocket, EventSource, and XMLHttpRequest constructors, an aliased axios method, and a request through an axios.create() client.
reproduction.afterFix: Static aliases and destructured browser constructors, navigator.sendBeacon methods, aliased axios methods, and requests through statically created axios clients fail the source-isolation gate.

rootCause: The source gate matched common outbound APIs as direct source-text calls and did not resolve aliases for network constructors or request methods.
remediation: Resolve statically declared aliases for browser network constructors, sendBeacon, and axios request methods in the TypeScript AST; reject their use without executing resource source.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "network constructors invoked through static aliases"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: static WebSocket, EventSource, and XMLHttpRequest aliases returned pass
validation.additionalRedBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "aliased browser and HTTP client network APIs"
validation.additionalRedBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: aliased axios.get and a request through an axios.create() client returned pass
